agentGuide: Base path /api/v3. Movies: GET /api/v3/movie (id, title, year, hasFile, monitored); one: GET /api/v3/movie/<id>; missing: GET /api/v3/wanted/missing?pageSize=20. Find a film: GET /api/v3/movie/lookup?term=<title>; add it: POST /api/v3/movie with the lookup object plus qualityProfileId, rootFolderPath, monitored: true, addOptions: {"searchForMovie": true}. Commands: MoviesSearch (movieIds), RefreshMovie, RssSync. Queue: GET /api/v3/queue; history: GET /api/v3/history?pageSize=20; calendar: GET /api/v3/calendar?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD; health and version: GET /api/v3/health, /api/v3/system/status. Profiles and folders before adding: GET /api/v3/qualityprofile, /api/v3/rootfolder. Searches and refreshes are commands: POST /api/v3/command {"name": "..."}. Never send the key, it is set automatically.
